newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica has intensified talks - CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica has intensified talks - CNMV.

text.p: Spanish telecommunications group Telefonica de Espana has intensified talks with different operators and expects to finalise them in coming days, the stock market commission CNMV said on Thursday.
"In recent weeks we have had contacts with different operators to reach an accord with the aim of finding a strategic partner," Telefonica reported to the CNMV in a brief statement.
"In yesterday's board meeting different options were analysed and the chairman was authorised to continue and possibly to finalise the talks in coming days," the CNMV said.
Chairman Juan Villalonga said in March the company expected to announce a U.S. alliance within six weeks.
Telefonica said it would continue to announce significant events and gave no further details.
